Name: Deer - Horse Retexture
Author: SaesinArt
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/44Qs2kDz/How-to-install.png[/img]
﻿﻿﻿﻿[/center][center][url=http://]﻿1.[/url]﻿ Download Content Patcher and SMAPI.
[url=http://]2.[/url]﻿ Drop this mod inside your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
[url=http://]3[/url][url=http://].[/url]﻿[url=http://][/url]﻿ Done! You can now have a little deer in your game.

[url=http://]→ [/url]﻿If you want to use a deer texture that isn't the default (brown) one, run the game to generate a config.json file, then close the game. Open the config.jason file and change "Deer" to the texture you want (texture names are in the reference folder).
[url=http:]→ [/url] You can easily alternate between textures while in game using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Config Mod[/url]﻿.


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hGB256Wd/Features.png[/img]
﻿
[url=http:]→ [/url]﻿ Four deer skin colors.
[url=http:]→ [/url]﻿ Two antlers option for each color.

[b]Future features:[/b]
[url=http:]→[/url] Mystical/magic deer skin.
[url=http:]→[/url] Optional flower crown for the deer skins.
[url=http:]→[/url] Optional flowing leaves (to match green skin).
[url=http:]→[/url] Seasonal version (suggested by DummyAccount03).



[size=3]If you want any new color, have any feedback or tips to give me, please feel free to contact me through the comments or DMs! This is my first mod, so I'm still new to this.[/size]

[size=5]
❤ [b]Credits[/b] ❤
[/size]This mod is inspired by an old mod that I used to play with, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/924?tab=description]Rideable Deer[/url], and the new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20042]Elle's Cuter Horses[/url]﻿.﻿ Both are amazing mods and I recommend you guys to check them out!
